tests.name: Parity of the XGBoost artifact (score() vs. real XGBClassifier)
tests.detail: routing mismatches vs. booster's own leaf index = 0/200000 (tree, row) pairs; base-value spread = 1.45e-06; max |score()_margin - xgboost_margin| = 1.79e-06 across 1000 rows (tolerance 1e-5, the same float32-precision bar ml/train.py's own export-time check uses)
tests.note: Resolves an open question from the deployment wave: ml/train.py's own export-time parity check (xgb_tree_sum) and api/predict.py's live score() both route XGBoost ties with a strict '<', confirmed here directly against the fitted booster's own leaf indices with zero mismatches. The real measured max margin difference on this run is 1.79e-06, not the 2.61e-07 figure previously written into the report (which predates this fresh, from-source measurement) -- the report has been corrected to match.
